As we all know, both groups have their next two forums scheduled for the same week, and attendance has been declining at both since they began sharing several company-wide initiatives. I'm considering whether a combined forum might make sense here, and I have the authority to approve that along with any temporary operating rules. But before I make any decision, I want to hear from each of you — the ERG chairs, our HR business partner, and our executive sponsor. Please raise any concerns, constraints, policy requirements, or prior commitments you think should shape this decision. What are we working with?
